prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical close-up portrait of a young adult woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, with East Asian–appearing facial features, posing playfully inside a softly illuminated modern indoor room. She has a delicate oval face with a softly tapered jawline, smooth rounded cheeks, a petite straight nose, a small refined chin, and naturally full, beautifully shaped rosy-red lips. Her complexion is exceptionally fair with subtle warm-pink undertones, realistic fine skin texture, delicate rosy blush across her cheeks, and soft luminous highlights along her forehead, nose, shoulders, collarbones, and upper chest.

Her large, expressive dark brown almond-shaped eyes feature subtle eyeliner, softly blended neutral-brown eyeshadow, long curled eyelashes, and bright natural catchlights. Her eyebrows are delicately shaped and partially concealed by her straight bangs. She gazes directly into the camera with a sweet, playful, subtly flirtatious expression, her head tilted gently toward one shoulder and her lips forming a small, confident closed-mouth smile.

Her sleek, straight, dark chocolate-brown hair is styled in a smooth chin-to-shoulder-length bob with softly inward-curving ends and thick, precisely cut eyebrow-length bangs. A few delicate strands frame her cheeks, while the glossy hair catches soft highlights from the surrounding light.

She has a slender yet naturally curvaceous figure, with narrow shoulders, a defined waist, a full, naturally proportioned bust, and graceful arms. She leans slightly forward toward the camera in a relaxed seated pose, with her torso subtly angled and one shoulder closer to the lens. Her right hand is raised beside her face, forming a cheerful V-shaped peace sign, displaying pale blue nail polish and a delicate ring.

She wears a fitted white strapless corset-inspired bustier top featuring a sweetheart neckline, structured bust cups, delicate vertical seam detailing, and a snug, sculpted silhouette. Light blue denim jeans are partially visible at the bottom of the frame. A slim gold chain-strap handbag crosses diagonally over her shoulder and torso. Accessories include a delicate gold necklace with a small black four-leaf-clover pendant, stacked gold bracelets, and understated rings.

The background features cream-colored walls, a vertical doorway or sliding panel, a small red wall fixture, pale cabinetry, and partially visible dark furniture, softly blurred to maintain visual emphasis on the subject. Gentle diffused indoor lighting produces flattering skin tones, soft dimensional shadows, and subtle reflections in her hair and jewelry.

Captured from a slightly elevated, intimate smartphone portrait perspective, with close framing from the head to the upper hips, realistic 35mm-equivalent lens characteristics, subtle shallow depth of field, crisp facial detail, natural anatomical proportions, refined skin detail, soft pastel color grading, warm-neutral highlights, delicate pink undertones, understated cinematic contrast, and an authentic high-resolution lifestyle photography aesthetic. Vertical composition, aspect ratio 9:16.
